The sheet starts near candidate y=332 and reference y=666 / 2; no image measurement or processing was performed.

The sheet retains two aligned sorting columns, four rows, a separated direction row, and four neutral filter chips. Its roughly 22-pixel side insets, uniform row gaps and control extents visibly correspond to the related reference. No control label crosses an outline or overlaps an adjacent control.

The Done control appears slightly narrower on the candidate than the normalized related reference; the approximate visible widths are 72 versus 76 pixels. Its right edge, height and label clearance remain aligned. This records a related-layout difference without granting exact geometric parity.

The neutral title-sort choice uses the candidate wording meaning By book name while the related reference uses Title. This observed wording variance is retained; the four assigned selected-sort labels agree with their corresponding visible controls.

The reference selects Recent read and New to Old, while every assigned candidate selects its assigned mode and Old to New. Selected-state differences are expected comparison limits, not an exact-state visual claim.
